about_short_description.short_description: Symbotic is a provider of integrated supply network automation solutions for warehouses and distribution centers.

product.name: Symbotic Solution
product.description: An end-to-end warehouse automation system combining robotic material handling, automated storage and retrieval, pallet building, inventory management, and AI-driven operational control.

product.name: Distribution Solution
product.description: An automated distribution-center system that handles goods in their native cases from pallet receiving through storage, order building, and outbound pallet preparation.

product.name: SymMicro
product.description: A micro-fulfillment system for individual-item and small-unit orders that stores goods in totes and automatically presents them to operators at ergonomic pick stations.

product.name: AI-Driven Software
product.description: Proprietary software that coordinates warehouse robots, inventory movement, task routing, order sequencing, pallet building, analytics, and real-time operational adjustments.

product.name: Robots
product.description: A portfolio of robotic hardware used for case transport, storage and retrieval, item handling, pallet building, and other automated warehouse operations.

product.name: Warehouse-as-a-Service
product.description: A managed fulfillment service providing access to fully automated warehouses, robotics, software, fulfillment capacity, and transportation services through Symbotic’s Exol network.
